roles.title: AI Engineer
roles.summary: Legal-sector AI automation: lead intake, qualification, outbound calling and case-status reporting.
bullets: Built automated lead intake, qualification, routing, follow-up, and case-status workflows using n8n, Make.com, Google Sheets, and APIs.
Developed AI outbound calling with Retell AI covering lead qualification, scheduled callbacks, live-agent transfers, voicemail handling, and call-result tracking.
Integrated OpenAI and Perplexity for legal FAQ support, content enrichment, and AI-assisted workflow decisions.
Created GoHighLevel workflows for lead tagging, routing, appointment scheduling, communication tracking, DND/opt-out management, and pipeline updates.
Built an n8n error-monitoring workflow that captures failed executions and sends them to an AI debugging agent for diagnosis.
Implemented retry controls, STOP/DND handling, validation rules, and scheduling safeguards, and unified transcripts, SMS replies, transfers, and case statuses into structured reporting.

roles.title: AI SaaS Developer
roles.summary: AI pet-travel compliance platform built around a LangGraph agent that turns destination rules into actionable tasks.
bullets: Built an AI pet-travel compliance platform (React, FastAPI, Supabase/PostgreSQL) in which a LangGraph agent reads country-specific destination rules and generates required tasks, deadlines, documents, and a readiness score.
Integrated Stripe checkout and payment reconciliation, Zoho CRM sync, Resend transactional email, scheduled reminders, and full EN/ES localization.
Delivered trip management, billing, document upload, and validation workflows, replacing manual research with a guided flow that catches errors before departure.

achievements.label: Multi-Agent Production Delivery
achievements.detail: Designed and deployed TravelCrewAI, a supervisor-based multi-agent LLM platform, to a production VPS with human-in-the-loop approval, guardrails, LangSmith tracing, and CI/CD.

achievements.label: Agentic Workflow Automation
achievements.detail: Replaced manual pet-travel compliance research at Seiton Paw with a LangGraph agent that generates country-specific checklists, deadlines, and readiness scores, integrated with Stripe, Zoho CRM, and EN/ES localization.

achievements.label: Reliable AI Operations
achievements.detail: Automated legal lead intake, AI calling, SMS follow-up, scheduling, and CRM updates at Robinson & Associates, with retry, STOP/DND, and duplicate-prevention safeguards and an AI-assisted n8n error-diagnosis workflow.

achievements.label: Analytics Data Quality
achievements.detail: Delivered a GCP ELT pipeline into a BigQuery star schema with a dbt layer adding lineage and column-level tests for trusted Looker Studio reporting.

achievements.label: End-to-End MLOps
achievements.detail: Reached 87% accuracy on a U.S. visa approval classifier with MLflow-tracked experiments and automated deployment to AWS ECR/EC2 via GitHub Actions.
